The '''2009 [[Tippeligaen]]''' was the 65th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The competition began on 15 March and end on 1 November. [[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] were the defending champions. [[Odd Grenland]], [[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]] and [[IK Start|Start]] entered as the three promoted teams from the [[2008 1. divisjon]]. They replaced [[HamKam]] who were relegated to the [[2009 1. divisjon]].

==Overview==
===League expansion===
This was the first top division seasons where 16 teams were competing on the highest level of Norwegian football since the [[1961–62 Hovedserien]] season. Due to the league expanding from 14 to 16 teams,<ref name="expansion">{{cite web|title=Tippeligaen utvides til 16 lag |work=Football Association of Norway |url=http://www.fotball.no/table.asp?p=53184&cat=51834&x=1&a=221127 |archive-url=https://archive.today/20080804140606/http://www.fotball.no/table.asp?p=53184&cat=51834&x=1&a=221127 |url-status=dead |archive-date=2008-08-04 |access-date=2008-03-09 |date=2008-03-08 |language=no }}</ref> three teams were promoted from the [[2008 1. divisjon|1. divisjon]] at the end of the 2008 season. Those teams were champions [[Odd Grenland]], runners-up [[Sandefjord Fotball|Sandefjord]] and third-placed [[IK Start|Start]]. The last spot was taken by [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]] after winning a [[2008 Tippeligaen#Relegation play-offs|two-legged play-off match]] against [[Sogndal Fotball|Sogndal]].

===Summary===
[[Stabæk Fotball|Stabæk]] was the defending champions, having won their first ever [[Norwegian football league champions|League Championship]] in 2008. On 27 September, [[Rosenborg BK|Rosenborg]] secured the title with four rounds left to go.<ref name="Strømsheim">{{cite news|url=http://www.dagbladet.no/2009/09/27/sport/tippeligaen/fotball/rosenborg/erik_hamrn/8258507/|title=- RBK har vært helt overlegne|last=Strømsheim|first=Gro Wold|date=2009-09-27|publisher=[[Dagbladet]]|language=no|access-date=2009-09-27}}</ref> They won their 21st top-flight title.

== Relegation play-offs ==
{{main|2009 Eliteserien promotion/relegation play-offs}}
At the end of the season, the two last teams relegated directly to 1. divisjon, and were replaced by the winner and runner-up of the 1. divisjon who were directly promoted.

Four teams entered a play-off for the last Tippeligaen spot in the 2010 season. These were:
* A) [[Fredrikstad FK|Fredrikstad]] (14th placed team in the Tippeligaen)
* B) '''[[Kongsvinger IL Toppfotball|Kongsvinger]]''' (Third placed team in the 1. divisjon)
* C) [[Sogndal Fotball|Sogndal]] (Fourth placed team in the 1. divisjon)
* D) [[Sarpsborg 08 FF|Sarpsborg 08]] (Fifth placed team in the 1. divisjon)
{{#section-h:2009 Eliteserien promotion/relegation play-offs|bracket}}
